audit: Wave G1 — topology + bevel audit of the live Melusina hero VFX assets

rules: no frame changes (frame 107 before and after every probe)

evidence.method: all geometry read via BMesh.from_object(evaluated) copies + read-only datablock reads; transient meshes created by new_from_object were removed in the same scope

environment.blender: 5.2 (live GUI PID 30268 via exec socket localhost:9876)

defects.what: 1 zero-length edge (edge_len_min 0.0, zero_len_edges 1) and 1 vertex of valence 2 — a collapsed/pinched detail loop
defects.evidence: evaluated mesh: edge_len_min 0.0, zero_len_edges 1, valence_hist has one '2' bucket entry

defects.what: 2 coincident (unwelded) vertices
1239 edges crease >=30 deg (566 >=45, 308 >=60) and NOT one of them is marked sharp; the whole mesh is smooth-shaded, so hard rims (armour trim, boot soles, hem edges) shade as soft mush

active UV layer 'UVMap' has 85 zero-area faces (0.45%); second layer 'UV0' is 99.58% collapsed (18762/18842 zero-area) — dead layer

recommendations.op: Merge by Distance (GeometryNodeMergeByDistance or Edit>Mesh>Merge)
recommendations.why: removes the 1 zero-length edge + 2 coincident verts; measured p01 edge length 0.001386 so 1e-5 is 100x below the mesh's finest real detail

recommendations.op: do NOT blanket-bevel
recommendations.why: beveling all 1239 creases at 2 segments would add an estimated +2478 faces to an 18842-face organic body for no silhouette gain; the creases are in dense short-edge areas (crease_ge30_mean_edge_len 0.00652 vs median edge 0.01046)

recommendations.op: targeted bevel via MEL_bevel_profile (MeshBevel) on silhouette creases only
recommendations.why: 308 edges crease >=60 deg are the real hard silhouette; width cap 25% of the smallest crease-adjacent edge (0.000113 local) keeps clamp_overlap clean; est. cost +616 faces (<4% of the body)

recommendations.op: mark the sub-1% that must stay crisp with sharp_edge (Store Named Attribute 'sharp_edge' BOOLEAN on EDGE) or accept smooth
recommendations.why: replaces the current state where 100% of faces are smooth and 0 creases are marked

recommendations.op: delete/blank UV0 and fix the 85 zero-area faces in UVMap
recommendations.why: UV0 is 99.58% collapsed and is not the active/render layer; the 85 faces are texture-sampling holes

SheepHorns.kind: GN-generated (MEL_S5_horns, 90 nodes: ObjectInfo bbox anchor -> coil base circle res 32 -> Resample Curve Count 96 -> set_position coil -> transform place -> set_curve_radius taper -> Profile circle res 32 -> Curve to Mesh) x2 horns

materials.note: empty slot, no Set Material node in the chain

uv.note: Curve to Mesh output carries no UVs; horns have anisotropic brass/ivory detail and no UVs at all

defects.what: the coil is severely under-sampled along its length: 6256 of 12288 edges (50.9%) crease >=30 deg, 5518 >=45, 4455 >=60, 814 in the 150-180 bucket (surface folds). The circumferential 32-gon edges are clean (5458 edges at 5-15 deg) so the damage is purely longitudinal

edge length spread 130x (min 0.016583, p01 0.145117, median 0.196034, max 2.165144): the Resample Curve (Count 96) runs on the coil BASE CIRCLE before the set_position coil / transform place / sweep-rotation displacement, so each sample is then thrown far apart by the coil function
defects.evidence: edge_len stats; chain order: coil base 0 (Curve Circle res 32) -> coil resample 0 (Count 96) -> coil set 0 (Set Position) -> place 0 (Transform) -> horn mesh 0 (Curve to Mesh)

defects.what: 100% smooth shading with zero sharp marks over a surface that is 50.9% creases: no Set Shade Smooth/Bevel/sharp-edge handling at all
no UVs and no material on hero horns
topology itself is clean and uniform: 6144 quads, 100% valence-4, 0 poles, 0 non-manifold edges, 2 identical 3072-quad tube shells, open at both ends (chi = 0)

recommendations.op: move/extend the Resample Curve so it samples the DISPLACED coil, not the base circle

params.rationale: 96 rings over Coils 3.0 with A/B ratios 3.0/2.0 means the winding advances ~33.75 deg of phi per ring; 384 rings cuts that to ~8.4 deg

recommendations.why: this is the root cause of HORN-1/HORN-2: at 96 rings the longitudinal quads twist 33.75 deg each, which is exactly the measured 30-90 deg crease population. Cost: 384 x 32 = 12288 verts/horn (4x, still 0.15% of the 16.8M-face scene)

recommendations.op: or (cheaper, lookdev-only) reduce Coils 3.0 -> 1.5 and A/B ratios to <=2.0 so the current 96 shows no fold
recommendations.why: same visual family, ~2x fewer winding degrees per ring; use only if the 4x density is not wanted

recommendations.op: keep the profile at 32 (measured clean) and keep Set Curve Radius taper Root 0.028 -> Tip 0.006 (no pinch-to-zero, good)
recommendations.why: profile edges measure 5-15 deg = fine; Tip Radius 0.006 is 21% of Root, so no collapsed tip ring

recommendations.op: if the folds are intentional stylisation, mark them sharp (sharp_edge attribute on the >=60 deg edges) instead of leaving 100% smooth
recommendations.why: 814 fold edges currently interpolate into smeared blotches; sharp marks are free

recommendations.op: add GeometryNodeUVUnwrap + GeometryNodeUVPackIslands + Set Material at the end of MEL_S5_horns
recommendations.why: 0 UV layers on a 6144-quad horn means no grain, no anisotropy, and no brass material

recommendations.op: optional: bevel the root/tip rims only after step 1
recommendations.why: post-resample the smallest crease-adjacent edge is 0.004146 local; beveling earlier would be a no-op against the fold noise

bevel.note: do not bevel before fixing sampling: beveling 4455 >=60 deg edges would add ~8910 faces to a 6144-face object to hide a sampling error

known_gaps: No render/EEVEE evaluation was performed (EEVEE viewport shading was left untouched); all claims are geometry measurements.
Shading-impact claims (faceted teeth, smeared folds) are inferred from measured face smooth flags and dihedral angles, not from rendered images.
Dihedral angles are computed from face normals; on heavily twisted quads (horns) this can overstate smooth-surface sharpness — the >=150 deg bucket (814 edges) is the reliable fold evidence.
UV quality was measured only as per-face zero-area (collapse), not as stretching/texel density.
Valence/pole statistics are meaningful for the quad meshes (body, horns, hair cards) and deliberately not used as a quality score for the 1-wide ribbon wings or the tri-meshes (globs, teeth).
The wing 'Feather Count' dial reading 18 vs 20 realized blades was measured but its cause was not resolved (would need to trace the Math chain feeding the row count).
